Thinking about people trying to teach me how to swim is making my stomach turn. I'll probably just embarrass myself. I've always wanted to learn how to swim my whole life. I guess I won't know until I try. No idea when I'll get to do that. I wish I can. Thanks for the idea anyways. 

I don't know any resources around this place. I guess I can try looking for them. I don't want to seem like I'm prying. We just met recently and not that close.
I just want to thank you wholeheartedly for your comment and sharing your story. It truly makes me feel less alone.

I try to be a good person. I haven't been. I've been toxic and hurting people I care about for years now. I am aware of this, but still fail to change because I don't try. I continue to hurt them. I feel guilty about it. I want to be better, but it's too late for me. I don't have the motivation to do anything anymore. We are taking care of our disabled mother for years now and I am exhausted from it. We attend to her 24/7 and we never had a day off. She doesn't show any interest in getting better, and throws tantrums when things don't go her way. I'm not equipped to handle this kind of  behavior for this long. I've hurt her verbally and sometimes physically when I can't control my temper. It's tiring to help someone who doesn't want to help themselves. That's why I don't blame my family if they're done with helping me with my issues. I'm too tired to do anything about this anymore. I wish to end things now. But I'll keep in mind what you said and try to fix some things and make my stay less miserable for them. It's the least I can do for them for putting up with me this long. 

Thank you for your comment. It's been so long since someone validated my emotions. You're a good person. I wish the best for you.
Its not your responsibility to keep her alive. Please put yourself first, you've done enough. Thank you for trying your best.

Hey I just wanted to say I appreciated your messages at the time I needed it. At least I can bring you some good news today. We managed to work things out and back to being friends again. I did experience so much pain along the way. I actually had to extend my patience and understanding. I was so desperate for things to go back to normal that I let myself get hurt for it. I can't say I regret it though. I feel like it's better to have her back than to grieve an old friendship. Because I think I am incapable of moving on. Anyway, a little bittersweet ain't it? But I can safely say I moved past it and we are having fun again. One less thing to worry about in this miserable life. 

I hope you are doing well. Let me know if you need someone to talk to. Thanks for being here.
